main_text.p: per ea, dicens ; Si vel tu nôffes hoc faltem tuo die, quae ad pacem tuam pertinent ! Confer 2 Cor. v, 20.

XXXIII. Actûs morales à realibus accuratè distinguendi sunt: hi per illos non excluduntur ; sed ut praestetur obedientia, accedere debent. Alias tantùm obligatio ad officium infertur, & voluntas mandati innotescit ; cui dùm scientes & volentes refragantur homines, fiunt inexcusabiles : Ezech, II, 4, 5. Ut sciant Prophetam fuisse in medio sui. 2 Cor. II, 14. 15, 16. - His quidem odor mortis ad mortem.
XXXIV. Ad Praxin, 1. Providentiam Dei piè in omnibus contemplemur, & alios similiter excitemus: Psal. xciv, 8, 9, 10. Jef. xl, 26. Matth. vi, 26, 30. Act. xiv, 17. xvii, 24, 28.
2. Sub manû Omnipotentis humiliemur: Jac. iv, 7, 10. 1 Petr. v, 6.
3. Justissimum Dei Imperium in omnia agnoscamus, praedicemus: Job. 1, 21. Psal. cxv, 3. Dan. iv, 35.

4. Eum toto animo revereamur, qui intimè omnibus praesit, & in omnibus operatur: Act. xvii, 25, 28. Psal. xxxiii, 15. In Prosperis gratitudinem praestemus: Psal. cvii, 8. cxvi, 12. cxlv, 10, 15, 16. Jac. 1, 17. 1 Tim. vi, 17: Amemus: Psal. cxvi, 1. iv, 33. In Adversis coram Ipso patientes simus: Hebr. xii, 5, &c. Job. 1, 21. 2 Sam. xv, 10, 11.
5. Mediis ne nimium tribuamus: Psal. cxxvii, 1, 2. 2 Chron. xv, 12. Matth. iv, 4. Neque tamen temerè negligamus: Actor. xxvii. 31. Matth. iv, 7. 2 Reg. v, 13.

6. Omnem solicitudinem in Deum devolvamus: Psal. lv, 23. 1 Petr. v, 7. Hebr. xiii, 5, 6, Psal. xxiii, 1. 4, 6. 1 Sam. xvii, 37. 2 Tim. iv, 17, 18. Eph. iii, 19, 20. Rom. viii, 28. Gen. L, 20, xxii, 8.
7. Providentiam moralem, vitae nostrae regulam, respiciamus, & observemus perpetuò: Psal. cxix, 4, 5, 17, 18, 19; 33-37.

page.notes: Scan is a 17th-century Latin page; some words at line ends are faint. Doubtful readings: "Psal. cxix, 4, 5" and "Matth. iv" references, and "Actor." in paragraph 5. Italic runs are approximated.
